description: Add a skeleton and ready-made animation clips to one of the user's models (auto-rig), saved as a new rigged version shown in the 3D viewer. Paid — 30 credits per new rig (a repeat or a failed rig is not charged): tell the user the price and get their OK first. Takes a few minutes; may return a task_id for get_task. Afterwards list_animations names the clips and export_model gives FBX or GLB.

kind.description: auto (default: Wandy3D picks, free), humanoid (people and characters: idle, walk, run, jump, wave, dance …) or generic (four-legged animals walk and run, wheels turn, other objects get simple motions)

model_id.description: model_id of one of the user's models (list_models / get_task)

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before answering with a task_id (0–50 s, default 30)

name: rig_model
title: Rig a 3D model for animation
